rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you so much for reaching out — I really enjoyed meeting you at the meetup too, and I'm grateful for the offer. I'm still figuring out the best direction for Halcyon Threshold, but having someone with data analysis skills would be incredibly valuable. A few areas where I could use help: 1. Research synthesis — helping survey what's already being worked on in AI safety/governance so we can find genuinely neglected areas 2. Building a small database of organizations, grants, and resources in this space 3. Eventually, if we pursue evaluation work, data analysis would be central Would any of those appeal to you? Even something small to start would help me figure out how to best use your time. No pressure on timeline — let me know what sounds interesting and we can go from there. Thanks again, Morgan"
